reason: QA test to verify agent messaging and response functionality - Agent was found, opened, messaged, and responded with correct mathematical answer containing "4".

Found "QA-20261116-194117-wsea" agent in sidebar — Agent was visible in the "Your Agents" section with status "idle".
Clicked on "QA-20261116-194117-wsea" agent — Agent page opened successfully, showing agent name and idle status.
Verified agent status is "running" or "idle" — Status indicator showed "idle", which meets the requirement.

Took screenshot of the chat window — Screenshot captured successfully showing the full conversation.
